description: This file defines classes and templates for handling Netlink messages within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes classes for constructing, parsing, and managing Netlink messages, frames, and socket communication, specifically for Linux systems. The file also contains nested classes for message parameters, frames iteration, and connector types, as well as a socket class for Netlink communication.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Base class representing a Netlink message, providing serialization, deserialization, and sequence management.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: Template class for constructing Netlink message parameters with buffer management.

classes.name: Frames
classes.description: Class for iterating over Netlink message frames within a received data buffer.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: Template class for specific connector message types, handling acknowledgment and message parsing.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Class for managing Netlink socket communication, including sending, receiving, and message exchange.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the constructed Netlink message.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the Netlink message with specified type and value.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current frame is valid within the buffer.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances to the next frame in the buffer.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the message type.

methods.name: Sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the message.

methods.name: Flags
methods.description: Returns the message flags.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the message data.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the size of the message payload.

methods.name: RawData
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the raw message data.

methods.name: RawSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the raw message.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into a Netlink message.

methods.name: Acknowledge
methods.description: Returns acknowledgment status for connector messages.

methods.name: Ingest
methods.description: Ingests a stream of data into the Netlink message.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Pure virtual method to be implemented for message-specific serialization.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a Netlink message through the socket.

methods.name: Exchange
methods.description: Performs a send and receive exchange of Netlink messages.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming data frames into Netlink messages.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data through the socket.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Receives data from the socket.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes.
